meta.name: board-bringup
meta.description: Custom board bringup for Zephyr RTOS using Hardware Model v2 (HWMv2). Covers directory structure, board.yml metadata, core configuration files (Kconfig, defconfig, CMake), and revision management. Trigger when creating new board definitions or porting Zephyr to custom hardware.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为自定义硬件创建 Zephyr 板级支持包
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 Zephyr RTOS 中为新硬件定义板级配置
copy.tagline_en: Create Zephyr board support for custom hardware
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to define board configuration for new hardware in Zephyr RTOS

howto.what: 依据 Zephyr RTOS 的 Hardware Model v2 标准，指导你创建或移植自定义板卡定义，包括组织目录结构、填写 board.yml 元数据、配置 Kconfig、defconfig 和 CMake 文件，并管理硬件修订版本。
howto.when: 当你需要为自定义硬件创建新的 Zephyr 板卡定义，或将 Zephyr 移植到自定义硬件上时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个新板卡骨架，厂商名是myvendor，板名是myboard。
为我的板卡添加一个修订版，只修改某些外设的引脚。
验证我的 board.yml 文件是否符合 HWMv2 规范。

howto.what_en: Guides you to create or port custom board definitions for Zephyr RTOS using Hardware Model v2 (HWMv2), covering directory structure, board.yml metadata, Kconfig, defconfig, CMake files, and revision management.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create new Zephyr board definitions for custom hardware or port Zephyr to custom hardware.

say_en.text: Create a board skeleton for my custom board with vendor 'myvendor' and board name 'myboard'.
say_en.note: Claude generates the basic files under boards/myvendor/myboard/.

say_en.text: Add a revision for my board that changes some peripheral pin assignments.
say_en.note: Claude guides you to define multi-revision in board.yml.

say_en.text: Validate my board.yml file against HWMv2 conventions.
